gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross run-off strengthening of GBP 20.6 million for prior accident years, representing 1.45% of its opening gross claims reserves. This strengthening was split between a GBP 10.9 million deficit for reinsurance accepted business and a GBP 9.7 million deficit for direct business. A significant driver of the net adverse prior year development was Marine Liability, impacted by increasing personal injury claims costs and social inflation, as well as updates to expected loss ratios and development patterns.

driven predominantly by one class of business; Marine Liability which makes up 60% of the figure above or GBP 12.5m. The remaining impact for this class is from updates to expected loss ratios and development patterns in response to the emerging experience.
